title: 福祉心理学
subtitle: Psychology for Social Welfare
educationalGoal:
Students will learn the basic knowledge and skills to provide psychological support in the social welfare field.
Students must learn:
1.	Psychosocial problems in the welfare field
2.	Psychological supportive approach for abuse and dementia care
3.	The role of psychologists at welfare sites
advice:
The course aims to introduce social welfare from a psychological point of view. Students will discuss psychological support for people who are in need of assistance.
The course gives students advice to consider psychological support that corresponds to social needs.
Students should understand welfare services and facilities in their own local community.
Students are expected to read the reference book and other books related to abuse and dementia.
The course asks students to answer questionnaires about mental health and welfare to fully understand what is welfare. However, these questionnaires are not mandatory.
books: Textbooks: Psychology for Social Welfare, Tomi Publishers, Inc.
requiredKnowledge: Students need to read books related to social welfare service (public assistance, welfare for the disabled, child welfare, elderly welfare, etc.). In addition, students should find psychological support in social welfare services in their local community, and should consider what kind of psychological support they want to receive. Students are expected to apply the knowledge of and skills in Psychology for Social Welfare to their personal well-being and to the well-being of others.

              Students will learn the basic knowledge and skills to provide psychological support in the social welfare field.
Students must learn:
1.	Psychosocial problems in the welfare field

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              The course aims to introduce social welfare from a psychological point of view. Students will discuss psychological support for people who are in need of assistance.
The course gives students advice to consider psychological support that corresponds to social needs.
Students should understand welfare services and facilities in their own local community.
Students are expected to read the reference book and other books related to abuse and dementia.
The course asks students to answer questionnaires about mental health and welfare to fully understand what is welfare. However, these questionnaires are not mandatory.

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

              Textbooks: Psychology for Social Welfare, Tomi Publishers, Inc.

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              Students need to read books related to social welfare service (public assistance, welfare for the disabled, child welfare, elderly welfare, etc.). In addition, students should find psychological support in social welfare services in their local community, and should consider what kind of psychological support they want to receive. Students are expected to apply the knowledge of and skills in Psychology for Social Welfare to their personal well-being and to the well-being of others.
